title: Siri LED Controller
assumptions: Bluetooth protocol will be discovered iteratively during development using nRF Connect; initial LEDCommandEncoder uses placeholder/guessed format for common RGB controllers
No scene presets (named scenes) — user decided against this in brainstorm
Query intents included for Siri status queries (e.g., 'Hey Siri, what's the bedroom light status?')
Widget timeline shows current state and next scheduled change
Animation/transition support only if hardware supports it (to be discovered during reverse engineering)
Local notifications when schedule fails to execute
Background execution via BGAppRefreshTask every ~15 min + local notification fallback + bluetooth-central background mode
Single iPhone + Apple Watch, personal distribution via Xcode/TestFlight only
iOS 17+ / watchOS 10+ only, no backward compatibility

checkpoints.title: Xcode Project Setup
checkpoints.goal: Create Xcode project with all required targets, capabilities, and shared framework structure for iPhone app, Watch app, Widget extension, and shared code
tasks: Create Xcode project 'SiriLEDController' with iOS 17+ deployment target
Add SwiftUI, SwiftData, CoreBluetooth, App Intents, BackgroundTasks capabilities to main target
Add Watch App target (watchOS 10+) with shared SwiftUI code
Add Widget Extension target for lock/home screen widgets
Create shared framework/package 'LEDCore' for models, BLEManager, LEDCommandEncoder, ScheduleEngine, and App Intents entities
Configure code signing for personal distribution (Xcode/TestFlight)
Add required entitlements: bluetooth-central, background-modes (bluetooth-central, background-fetch)
Set up SwiftData model container in shared framework
Configure build settings for all targets (Swift 5.9+, strict concurrency)
acceptance: Project builds successfully for iPhone, Watch, and Widget targets
All capabilities (Bluetooth, Background Fetch, App Intents) are enabled in entitlements
Shared LEDCore framework compiles and is accessible from all three targets
SwiftData model container initializes without errors
No build warnings or errors

behavior.note: Project structure verified; xcodebuild verification requires macOS

checkpoints.title: Data Models + SwiftData Stack
checkpoints.goal: Define LEDDevice and WeeklySchedule SwiftData models with relationships, and set up the persistence stack
tasks: Create LEDDevice model: id (UUID), name (String), room (String), serviceUUID (String), characteristicUUID (String), isConnected (Bool), lastKnownState (Data?), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date)

Create WeeklySchedule model: id (UUID), device (Relationship to LEDDevice), name (String), weekdaysOn (Date), weekdaysOff (Date), weekendOn (Date), weekendOff (Date), targetColor (Data), targetIntensity (Double), targetColorTemp (Double), isEnabled (Bool), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date)
Define color state encoding: RGBCCT as 5-channel Data (R, G, B, WW, CW each 0-255)
Set up SwiftData ModelContainer in Persistence.swift with cloudKitContainer: nil
Add model migrations placeholder for future schema changes
Create preview data for SwiftUI previews
Add unit tests for model encoding/decoding and relationships
acceptance: LEDDevice and WeeklySchedule models compile with correct property types and relationships
SwiftData ModelContainer initializes in-memory for previews and on-disk for app
RGBCCT encodes/decodes 5-channel data correctly
Unit tests pass for model creation, relationship, and color encoding

behavior.note: Models and persistence implemented; swift test verification requires macOS

checkpoints.title: BLEManager Actor + LEDCommandEncoder (Lotus Lantern Protocol)
checkpoints.goal: Implement thread-safe BLEManager actor for CoreBluetooth operations and LEDCommandEncoder with actual Lotus Lantern 9-byte frame protocol
tasks: Create BLEManager actor with: CBCentralManagerDelegate, CBPeripheralDelegate
Implement scanForDevices(), connect(to:), disconnect(from:), writeCommand(_:to:), readState(from:), writeSequence()
Add connection state management: disconnected, scanning, connecting, connected, failed
Implement automatic reconnection with exponential backoff
Add GATT Inspector: discoverServices, discoverCharacteristics, service/characteristic info streams
Configure Lotus Lantern UUIDs: Service FFF0, Write FFF3, Read FFF4
Create LEDCommandEncoder protocol with methods: encodePower(on:), encodeColor(r:g:b:), encodeWhite(ww:cw:), encodeBrightness(_:), encodeColorTemp(kelvin:), encodeEffect(_:), encodeFullStateSequence()
Implement LotusLanternEncoder with 9-byte frame: 7E LEN CMD D0 D1 D2 D3 00 EF
Add unit tests for encoder with Lotus Lantern protocol formats
Add mock BLEManager for UI testing
acceptance: BLEManager actor compiles and handles CoreBluetooth delegate callbacks correctly
GATT Inspector discovers services/characteristics with proper UUID mapping
LotusLanternEncoder produces valid 9-byte frames for all commands
Unit tests pass for encoder (power, color, white, brightness, color temp, effect, sequences)
Mock BLEManager works for UI testing

behavior.note: BLEManager with GATT Inspector and LotusLanternEncoder implemented; swift test verification requires macOS
